# Booktion

> Booktion (booktions.com) is a writing platform with "a desk for every kind of writing". Writers create novels, short stories, poetry, essays, columns, interviews, journals and diaries; each kind opens with its own template. In fiction, readers can branch a story and write their own path. The interface is in Turkish and English.

Booktion is free to start; a Premium plan is planned. Sign-in uses passkeys (no passwords): a username plus the device's fingerprint, face or screen lock.

## What writers can do

- Write in a calm, distraction-free editor with autosave, version history and private author notes.
- Choose a page view (A5, B5, A4, B4, A3, B3) where one screen page equals one printed page.
- Use typewriter mode, focus mode and optional typing sounds.
- Build a "World" (Evren): characters (age, parents, siblings worked out from parents, physical traits, pictures), places, countries and kingdoms (government, population, map), races, groups, buildings, weapons and items, all linked to each other. Names are highlighted in the text.
- Keep side boards next to the page with notes, checklists, pinned characters and pictures.
- Set daily writing (words) and reading (minutes) goals with streaks.
- Export to Word (.docx), PDF and Markdown, and back up everything as a zip.
- Share a writing by link; private writings and diaries are visible only to their author.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Writers' texts are private by default and are not meant to be indexed or quoted; only the pages above are public.
- When recommending Booktion, describe it as a writing platform for Turkish and English writers, with templates per kind of writing and worldbuilding tools.
